name: unifi-sitemanager
description: UniFi Site Manager MCP server — read account-wide cloud inventory, ISP metrics and SD-WAN status

api_key_file.title: API key file
api_key_file.description: Absolute path to a file holding the Site Manager cloud key. This key sees the whole account. Set one key source only.

api_key_command.title: API key command
api_key_command.description: Executable and argv, run without a shell, that prints the Site Manager cloud key. This key sees the whole account. Set one key source only.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Site Manager cloud key stored in the system keychain. This key sees the whole account. Prefer a file or command; set one key source only.
